### God's Faithfulness amidst Our Confusion
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-may-7-2014.html
Passage: Job 13:15
Points:
- Tragic loss and profound suffering can easily disorient our understanding of God.
- Unimaginable horrors, such as the Holocaust, have driven many people into despair and doubt.
- Believers such as Corrie ten Boom show that it is possible to remain faithful amid tragedy.
- Job's resolve to hope in God even unto death models victorious endurance.
- True servants of God testify to His enduring faithfulness even in seasons of deep confusion.

### Me-Ology or Theology?
Author: Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-november-2.html
Passage: Job 13:15
Points:
- Christians often fall into "me-ology," allowing difficult circumstances to distort their view of God.
- God's goodness and love are not measured by our immediate feelings or circumstances.
- Rather than listening to his wife's urge to curse God, Job held tightly to sound truth.
- Job 13:15 demonstrates the deliberate decision to trust God even when calamity strikes.
- God's faithfulness is permanently proven at the cross and resurrection of Jesus Christ.

### Trusting in God Through Suffering
Author: Derek Thomas
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/trusting-in-god-through-suffering
Passage: Job 13:15
Points:
- Job's declaration to hope in God even if slain establishes the posture believers need in suffering.
- Painful trials never justify questioning the essential righteousness and justice of God.
- Affliction reveals our own human frailty and exposes sins we might otherwise overlook.
- God lovingly disciplines His children through trials to conform them to Jesus Christ.
- True biblical wisdom comes from submitting to God’s sovereignty and resting in His mysterious purposes.
